01/About

Strategy meets execution.

I’m an experienced consultant who sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, with a focus on operations, process improvement, and project management.

My work is rooted in turning complex problems into clear, practical solutions, whether that means redesigning a process, shaping a strategy, or leading a transformation. I’ve worked with executives, frontline teams, and organizations to bring structure to ambiguity, connect the dots, and turn big ideas into meaningful outcomes.

I’m naturally curious and a little bit of an artist at heart. Want to see more of what I do? Explore the Behind the work page.

03/Selected work

Work I am proud of.

01 Healthcare System Optimization

Reducing patient leakage by 20% through data-driven process improvement

Turned an ambiguous patient leakage and volume challenge into a structured, data-driven approach. Working alongside clinical teams, I identified bottlenecks across the neurosurgery patient pathway and developed solutions to remove barriers and increase volume. The approach became a Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) now used across 7 hospitals.

02 Governance & Integration

Building the governance structure that brought two organizations together

Built a shared governance approach for two organizations that had never operated under a common model, identifying decision bottlenecks, clarifying ownership, and aligning 80+ leaders around a unified operating model. The governance structure moved from concept to execution within one month.

03 Portfolio & Program Management

Defining the future state for enterprise-wide transformation

Working across 9+ workstreams, I assessed 36 business functions across the organization to identify performance gaps, benchmark current practices against industry standards, and determine what was feasible within existing constraints. I translated those findings into a prioritized roadmap with clear ownership, sequencing, and actions for execution.

My recs, and what I thought

  • A Little Life Hanya Yanagihara I loved how slowly this one unfolded. You never quite knew what was coming, and the characters got more layered with every chapter. A bit of a heavy, emotional read, but worth it.
  • Flowers for Algernon Daniel Keyes A beautiful reminder not to take the simple things for granted. It made me think differently about intelligence, kindness, and what makes a life meaningful.
  • The Girl with the Louding Voice Abi Daré About finding your voice when the world has spent your whole life telling you to stay quiet. Adunni’s determination made this a hard one to put down.
  • Fourth Wing Rebecca Yarros My first fantasy book, and I had so much fun with it. Dragons, romance, politics, danger, constant twists, and a little bit of Game of Thrones energy. This would make a cool show.
  • Purple Hibiscus Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie A quiet but powerful coming-of-age story about family, control, and faith. I loved how much was said through the things the characters didn’t say.
  • The Nightingale Kristin Hannah It’s funny how many lives one person can live. I loved how it showed women and their contributions to historical events, the part that tends to get overlooked.
  • Stay With Me Ayobami Adebayo A hard look at the toll of infertility and social pressure, and at how childlessness gets treated as a marital failure and a public burden in a rigid patriarchal society. It shouldn’t be.
